links.effect: Static 1-shot ICL showed high membership disclosure risk; static 2-3 shots markedly reduced risk; dynamic ICL kept F1 near chance with M approx 0 or slightly negative across all k.
links.quote: Dynamic ICL consistently suppresses disclosure across all $k$, with F1 near chance and $M \approx 0$ or slightly negative, signifying negligible exploitable signal.
